summary: Iter22 testing: POS settings API (GET/PUT with role guards, validation), inventory allocate with min stock per channel + backward compat, low-stock-alerts (critical/warning/watch), Reports PDF export, Profile POS setting admin-only. Backend: 21/21 pytest PASSED. Frontend: all 4 flagged UI features verified via Playwright with correct data-testids (setting-margin-input, setting-round-select, setting-margin-submit, setting-success, pos-margin-badge, low-stock-alert-panel, low-stock-alert-<sku>-<channel>, alloc-min-<Channel>, report-export-pdf-button, print-only-full). Admin can update margin -> 75% / round 5000 -> setting-success visible -> POS badge live-updates to 'MARGIN 75% · BULAT Rp 5.000'. Kasir profile does NOT show setting section (isAdmin gate correct). window.print() firing on PDF button click confirmed. Low-stock returned 4 alerts for LIN-OVR-001 across 4 channels. Margin restored to 60/1000 after tests.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L716 POSSettingsInput uses default_margin_pct: float — accepts values like 60.5. UI limits step=1 but API allows fractional. Non-blocking, but consider Field(..., ge=0, le=500) with pydantic v2 for consistent 422 via schema.

server.py L697 low-stock-alerts filters {channel_min_stock: {$exists: true}} — SKUs that never had allocate() called are excluded even if all channels are 0. Intentional (min>0 required), but note: if admin removes min by setting to 0 the SKU still shows in query but is skipped by min_val<=0 guard. Fine.
server.py L707 severity logic: `if current <= min_val: severity = 'critical'/'warning'/'watch'` — since 'watch' only fires when current==min_val AND current>0, boundary is correct. Verified in tests.

Allocate endpoint accepts int OR dict per channel — mixing is fine, but there's no test that mixed body ({Shopee:5, Tokopedia:{qty:3,min:1}}) works. Added dict-only and int-only paths. Consider adding mixed test in future.

App.js POS computePrice uses `Math.round(price/rt)*rt` (round-half) but requirement says 'dibulatkan ke atas' in the settings help text. Actual UI text says 'dibulatkan ke atas ke pembulatan' but code uses nearest. Minor inconsistency between copy and behavior — either update copy to 'dibulatkan ke terdekat' or change to Math.ceil.
